families.examples_from_original: Current APIs, saved bundles and registry/area contracts
families.critical_boundary: Reconcile physical IDs and registry IDs explicitly; preserve previous identifiers and references
families.scope: Legacy read adapter and parity; new model does not replace historical IDs.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: GeoPackage, Shapefile sets, GeoJSON, GML, feature APIs, CSV/XML registers
families.critical_boundary: ULPIN alone supplies an identifier, not a boundary; preserve issuer, source validity and ambiguous matches
families.scope: Existing bounded parcel GIS/identifier profiles; no national issuance or validity claim.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: GeoJSON, GeoPackage, Shapefile, ArcGIS feature JSON, OSM XML/PBF, database export
families.critical_boundary: A roof outline is not automatically ground occupation; unknown height stays unknown
families.scope: Qualified current GIS footprint profiles with unknown heights and roof/ground roles.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: GIS polygons, codes, boundary schedules, reviewed manual boundaries
families.critical_boundary: Administrative hierarchy is not physical containment or ownership; coverage may overlap
families.scope: Existing areas plus non-exclusive memberships; authoritative boundary integration deferred.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: GIS line/surface layers, CAD, LandXML/IFC/OpenDRIVE profiles, survey schedules
families.critical_boundary: Centreline, physical surface and recorded road land remain separate; crossing does not prove connectivity
families.scope: Supported line/surface roads with explicit width/height; richer alignment formats are elected later.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: GIS, IFC infrastructure, CAD/alignment profiles and asset registers
families.critical_boundary: Do not infer a junction at an overpass or derive track geometry from service schedules
families.scope: Extension boundary only initially; bridges/overpasses may be synthetic topology fixtures, not a full rail adapter.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.family: Water, sewer, drainage, gas and telecom assets
families.examples_from_original: GIS, CAD/as-built drawings, IFC MEP, CSV profiles and asset APIs
families.critical_boundary: Depth needs a reference surface; diameter is not a restriction width; keep unknown alignment/depth distinct
families.scope: Supported utility/declared profile fixtures; actual as-built formats and accurate depth require evidence.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: Utility GIS, IFC MEP, pole/cable schedules, CAD and asset registers
families.critical_boundary: Electrical connectivity is not identical to geometric proximity; overhead shape may be unknown
families.scope: Supported generic utility context only; full electrical connectivity/profile ingestion is later.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: IFC/IFCZIP and explicit vendor-export profiles
families.critical_boundary: Interpret units, nested placements and map conversion; IfcSpace is not automatically a registered flat; preserve unsupported constructs
families.scope: One selected IFC version/export profile per task; no complete or lossless BIM claim.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: CityGML/CityJSON and declared encodings/versions
families.critical_boundary: Do not equate source LOD with evidence completeness or flatten multipart objects into boxes
families.scope: Selected CityJSON/CityGML profiles; semantic/placement and source LOD mappings tested.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: DXF/DWG/DGN, PDF/vector exports; proprietary native files via supported exports
families.critical_boundary: Units and layer meaning may be absent; a closed polyline need not mean a property boundary; SDK/dependency checks required
families.scope: CAD attachment preservation only if supported by a safe receipt path; semantic CAD extraction deferred.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: PDF, PNG/JPEG/TIFF, SVG/CAD profiles and plan sets
families.critical_boundary: Attachment works without extraction. Scale, geographic placement and vertical placement are separate readiness gates
families.scope: Existing permitted plan attachments; calibration and editing follow later interface gates.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: CSV/XLSX/JSON, database/API export, tabular reports
families.critical_boundary: A table does not imply room geometry; floor labels are not numeric heights; reported areas are not recomputed areas
families.scope: Existing strict CSV level/space schedules and canonical interchange; arbitrary spreadsheets require a new mapping profile.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: GNSS processed solutions, total-station/levelling exports, CSV/LandXML/control files
families.critical_boundary: Raw/processed data must be distinguished; a CRS name alone does not establish vertical comparability or survey quality
families.scope: Retain current named control/frame facts; new GNSS/total-station/LandXML profiles separately qualified.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: RINEX and authorized station/correction products
families.critical_boundary: Do not draw parcel boundaries directly from raw observations; specialized processing and quality review required
families.scope: Raw GNSS assets and specialized processing are deferred; raw observations do not define parcels.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: LAS/LAZ, supported point-cloud packages, E57/PLY/XYZ profiles
families.critical_boundary: No point-per-row requirement; sensor sampling and occlusion do not prove interiors, ownership or complete watertight solids
families.scope: Typed cloud asset boundary now; real LAS/LAZ/E57 processing and segmentation deferred.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: DEM/DTM/DSM GeoTIFF and other declared raster/terrain/TIN profiles
families.critical_boundary: Do not silently use top-of-roof DSM as bare ground; vertical datum, gaps and resolution are mandatory metadata
families.planned_release: R1 declared ground fixture / R3 raster
families.scope: First renderer can use explicit synthetic/base ground; true DEM/DTM/DSM ingest needs a qualified coverage profile.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: Orthophotos, georeferenced rasters, drone images, calibrated cameras, generated meshes
families.critical_boundary: An ordinary screenshot is not a georeferenced survey; preserve acquisition date, resolution and processing lineage
families.scope: Aerial context remains attributed evidence; georeferencing/reconstruction is not assumed from screenshots.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: glTF/GLB, OBJ/FBX/export profiles, licensed 3D Tiles
families.critical_boundary: A visually rich mesh may have no interiors, usable semantic IDs, watertight solid or measurement suitability
families.scope: Use existing revision-bound models and compiler outputs; qualify formats/metadata and distinguish display from analytical suitability.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: Authorized register/API/database exports, CSV/XML/JSON and deed/document scans
families.critical_boundary: Record metadata without geometry remains searchable but unplaced; a document scan or importer is not legal adjudication
families.scope: Adapt existing records; authorized external registry connectors and legal validation are separate.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: Authorized CSV/API/property-management export, reviewed forms and optional agreements
families.critical_boundary: Living in a flat, owning it and logging into the app are distinct. Do not put PII or agreement URLs in public tiles
families.scope: Define private identity separation now; real resident/lease data and full access system are later authorized work.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.family: Water bodies, vegetation, terrain use and context
families.examples_from_original: GIS, classified imagery, field inventories, ecological/asset datasets
families.critical_boundary: A shoreline, bed, flood envelope and measured water level are different representations
families.scope: Render supplied/declared contextual shapes only; ecology, water level and land-cover ingestion need profiles.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.family: Web services and continuously delivered datasets
families.examples_from_original: OGC API Features/WFS, ArcGIS services, WMS/WMTS, authorized object catalogs and APIs
families.critical_boundary: Protocol is not a domain type; WMS images are not raw features; handle paging, rate limits, rights and incomplete acquisitions
families.planned_release: R1 existing service paths / R3 expansion
families.scope: Retain existing bounded acquisition where available; every new service needs paging, rights and completeness checks.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: Forms, tracing, measured edits, model proposals and canonical fixtures
families.critical_boundary: AI output cannot self-approve; preserve source locators and operator/model versions; synthetic alternatives must not contaminate observed world
families.scope: Canonical synthetic fixtures and controlled existing/manual candidates; AI never bypasses review.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.

families.examples_from_original: Time-series APIs/files for asset state, level, status or monitoring
families.critical_boundary: Not every observation revises the static building mesh; separate sampling quality from cadastral evidence
families.scope: Time-series/sensor asset boundary only initially; streaming observation integrations deferred.
families.actual_support_status: Not newly verified; preserve/parse/normalize/use must be qualified per profile.
